_meta.dataset: Hotel pricing + amenity evidence for Las Vegas stay
_meta.pricing_source_type: Booking.com public search results (aggregator). NOT the hotel's own booking engine. Prices change continuously and exclude resort fees unless stated.
important_caveats: Booking.com totals shown do NOT include Las Vegas resort fees/destination fees, which are charged at the property and often $25-$55 per night. Totals also exclude taxes in some displays.
A booking-site total is an offer, not a contract price. Re-verify on the hotel's own site before booking.
Las Vegas has NO subway/metro. Transit = RTC bus (Deuce/Strip & Downtown Express, residential routes) + Las Vegas Monorail. See transit.html.
